explanation: For the upper hemisphere g=√(4−x²−y²), the outward vector area element is ⟨x/g,y/g,1⟩ dA. Dotting with ⟨g²,0,y⟩ gives xg+y. The bottom disk points downward and contributes −y, so the combined integrand is x√(4−x²−y²), option e. The other choices also integrate to zero by symmetry, but e follows directly from the flux calculation.
